toolDefinitions.name: arms_zero
toolDefinitions.description: Move both real Piper arms to zero joint angles at fixed 10% speed. open_grippers=true also opens both grippers to device-reported maximum travel and RELEASES held objects; false leaves gripper targets unchanged. Require clearance for the full motion. No lift movement or automatic hardware fault reset. Success requires five fresh samples within 1 degree and, when opening, 1 mm. Failure/cancellation attempts electronic stop and latches a fault; software fault clearance does not reset device emergency stop.

timeout_s.description: Whole operation timeout, 0.1–600 seconds; normally 30 seconds.

open_grippers.description: Explicit choice: true opens and releases held objects; false preserves current gripper targets.

toolDefinitions.name: body_stop
toolDefinitions.description: Cancel this turn’s motion and wait for feedback. Inspect fault and stop acknowledgement; requesting stop does not establish physical rest. No further motion is admitted in this turn.

toolDefinitions.name: clear_motion_fault
toolDefinitions.description: Clear the console software motion-fault latch after the operator explicitly requests recovery and confirms the robot has stopped and the situation has been inspected. First read ego_state and use its current fault_id. Never invent operator confirmation or clear automatically after failure. No hardware reset, homing, movement, or retry is performed; previous failure evidence remains. Rejects active operations and stale fault IDs. Does not undo body_stop or enable motion; after stopping this turn, wait for a new operator turn before motion. A cleared latch does not prove hardware health or establish a lift origin.

fault_id.description: Exact current fault_id from ego_state; never guess or reuse an older fault ID.

operator_confirmed_stopped.description: Must be true only when the operator has explicitly confirmed physical rest and inspection for this fault.

reason.description: Operator-provided inspection/recovery reason, 1–1000 characters; not a claim of sensor verification.

toolDefinitions.name: ego_state
toolDefinitions.description: Read cached real-motion state, faults, configured map and fixed speed limits. Does not contact actuators or measure the current pose.

toolDefinitions.name: get_navigation_state
toolDefinitions.description: Read current chassis navigation feedback from the device, unlike cached ego_state. Returns absolute map x/y in meters, heading_deg from map +X, map name, localization validity, scheduler and navigation status, task identity and progress. Read-only: no movement, stop, reset or fault clearance. Available with a software fault or motion disabled. Require state=succeeded and pose_valid=true before using coordinates; reading successfully does not prove physical rest or navigation success. Receive timestamps are host times; the two topics are not an atomic sensor snapshot.

timeout_s.description: Wait for both feedback topics, 0.1–30 seconds; authentication and connection have separate bounded timeouts.

toolDefinitions.name: lift_move
toolDefinitions.description: Move the real lift. action=height sets an absolute integer height in mm (0–750); action=home moves DOWN to the physical limit and establishes zero, and must omit height_mm. Homing is explicit, never automatic. After motor power loss the operator must establish the origin with home before height moves. Fixed 400 RPM. Blocks; require state=succeeded before dependent work.

action.description: height moves to an absolute height; home explicitly moves down to the limit and establishes zero.

toolDefinitions.name: move_for_duration
toolDefinitions.description: Move the real chassis in its own body frame for a finite duration via the NAVIS virtual joystick. forward/backward translate along X; turn_left/turn_right rotate about Z; shift_left/shift_right translate along Y and require a chassis that supports lateral motion. Speed is a positive magnitude: default 0.2, hard maximum 0.5; translation uses m/s and rotation rad/s. Requires operator-provided direction and duration, clear space and no concurrent external controller/navigation task. No map target, localization, path planning or guaranteed obstacle avoidance. Publishes at 10 Hz and sends zero on completion or cancellation. state=succeeded means command transmission completed, NOT measured distance, angle or physical rest; inspect stop evidence and confirm rest before dependent work. Never automatically retry an uncertain result.

direction.description: Direction relative to the chassis; lateral shifts require compatible hardware.

speed.description: Positive magnitude, greater than 0 and at most 0.5. Default 0.2. m/s for translation, rad/s for turning; direction supplies the sign.

duration_s.description: Movement-command duration after connection/heartbeat, 0.1–60 seconds. Does not imply a precise traveled distance or turn angle.

toolDefinitions.name: navigate_to_pose
toolDefinitions.description: Move the real chassis to one absolute map pose. x/y are meters; heading_deg is degrees from map +X. Requires the named map already loaded and localized. Fixed 0.1 m/s and 0.1 rad/s, obstacle avoidance enabled. Blocks until success or failure; inspect state before dependent actions. Never retry an uncertain outcome. No object locations or routes are inferred.

x.description: Absolute map X coordinate in meters.

y.description: Absolute map Y coordinate in meters.

map_name.description: Exact name of the currently loaded and localized map.

toolDefinitions.name: skill
toolDefinitions.description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

toolDefinitions.name: wam_operate
toolDefinitions.description: Execute a prompt on the real dual-arm Cosmos WAM using live robot cameras. Load the applicable operation skill for material prompts and chunk budgets. Requires the chassis already stopped at the operation pose and a clear workspace. Fixed arm speed 25%; no navigation, lift, automatic zero, task classification or retries. state=succeeded means the finite chunk budget ran, NOT that grasp/place succeeded; task_success remains unknown. Inspect feedback and obtain operator confirmation before dependent release/zero if task success is unverified. Unknown outcomes latch a fault.

prompt.description: Exact operation instruction, 1–10000 characters; obtain material-specific text from a skill.

max_chunks.description: Finite number of server inference chunks, 1–1000; use skill or explicit operator value. No unlimited execution.

timeout_s.description: Whole operation deadline, 0.1–600 seconds, including startup and inference.

control_mode.description: Joint controller mode; default movej. Speed remains fixed.

model_fps.description: Expected server FPS, 1–60; default 30. Mismatch fails before arm enable.

expected_execute_steps.description: Optional required server execute_steps, 1–10000; mismatch fails before arm enable.

wait_tol_deg.description: Joint arrival diagnostic tolerance, 0.1–5 degrees; default 3.

v_max.description: Smoother joint velocity limit in rad/s, 0.01–3; default 3, does not override fixed motor speed.

savgol_window.description: Odd filter window, 3–101; default 11, greater than savgol_order.

butter_cutoff.description: Butterworth cutoff Hz, 0.01–40 and below half controller frequency; default 5.

gripper_close_threshold.description: Width at or below which to close, 0–0.08 meters; default 0.02.

save_prediction_video.description: Request and save model prediction video after execution; default false. Uses remaining timeout.
